description: This file defines a Drupal plugin class 'InputRequired' that extends 'ExposedFormPluginBase'. It provides an exposed form with required input functionality for views, including options for custom text display, handling filter application, and modifying view output based on user input.

classes.name: InputRequired
classes.description: A Drupal plugin class that provides an exposed form with required input, controlling view rendering based on user input.

methods.name: defineOptions
methods.description: Defines default options for the plugin, including custom text and format for required input message.

methods.name: buildOptionsForm
methods.description: Builds the configuration form for the plugin, allowing customization of the 'text on demand' message.

methods.name: submitOptionsForm
methods.description: Handles submission of the plugin's configuration form, saving user-defined options.

methods.name: exposedFilterApplied
methods.description: Checks if the exposed filter has been applied by the user.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the view for rendering, displaying custom text if no filter is applied.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Modifies the view's query to return no results if the filter is not applied, otherwise proceeds with default query execution.
